# Lead Routing Design Skill for Muse

Turns Muse into a RevOps designer for inbound lead assignment: it starts with a structured interview (ingestion paths, team shape, coverage hours, motion type, what "fair" means), then builds the precedence ladder top-down — legal overrides, named accounts, open opportunities, existing-account ownership, territory, eligibility, capacity/availability, fair allocation — with round-robin variants ranked by what they actually deliver (availability-checked straight rotation, capacity-based, weighted, full layered stack), a real monitored catch-all queue instead of a silent drop, an acceptance clock with SLA escalation, a synthetic test pack, and a sandbox → canary rollout plan. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: this designs the assignment logic, never the lead score itself (a sibling skill in the same repo covers scoring); it needs your real CRM facts to work — fields, pools, SLAs — so come with specifics, and never let a routing change ship straight to production. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
